name: PearlDriver NLAMM unchecked buy() cost overflow
summary: NLAMM.buy(token,index,amount) computes the USDT cost amount * currentPrice inside an unchecked block and then mints amount * 1e18 craft tokens. Choosing amount so the product wraps bought up to 1e63 tokens of five resources for fractions of a cent, sold into their PearlDEX USDT pairs; two copycats repeated it before the fix.
notes: CraftToken.mint is onlyVerifiedContract against Registry 0x840ebdce; NLAMM became a verified minter in the reset tx, after the NLAMM upgrade 0x372fd23e and the addToken listings of all five tokens, so buy() could only mint from then on (rule 8 mint grant).

Campaign: 0x2db1ab08 overflow-bought GOLDORE and NAIL and sold GOLDORE into pair 0x28f7d275 (the sells realise the minted tokens), and 0x9c862444 repeated the overflow buy. Loss is the USDT the six pairs paid out.
